papers.title: Satellite-based monitoring and hazard assessment of multiple flooding types in the Haihe river Basin induced by the July 2023 extreme rainstorm
papers.abstractEn: Under global climate change, extreme rainstorms are increasingly frequent, and a single storm in complex terrain often triggers flash floods, river floods, and waterlogging simultaneously. Most studies treat these floods uniformly with one data source. Focusing on the July 2023 extreme rainstorm in the Haihe River Basin, this study built a framework using multi-source satellite data to monitor different flood types and analyze their driving factors and hazards. In plains, Sentinel-1 and GF-3 SAR extracted inundation of river floods and waterlogging; in mountains, flash-flood areas were identified by combining Sentinel-2 NDVI changes with terrain and hydrological analysis. Random forest models compared driving factors and assessed hazards. Results show mountain flash floods concentrate in low-lying valleys with slope contributing 24.33%, while plains waterlogging differs markedly between urban and rural areas, dominated by distance to rivers (27.88%) and maximum daily rainfall (13.84%). A flood hazard map was produced, revealing the heterogeneity of flooding from a single extreme rainstorm.
papers.abstractZh: 极端暴雨频发，复杂地形一场暴雨常引发山洪、河洪与内涝。本文以2023年7月海河流域极端暴雨为对象，用多源卫星遥感区分洪涝类型并分析驱动因子。山区山洪集中于低洼河谷（坡度贡献24.33%）；平原城乡内涝差异显著，距河距离（27.88%）与最大日降雨量（13.84%）为主导。据此生成危险分布图，为防洪管理提供新思路。
papers.value: 以海河流域23·7极端暴雨为案例，多源遥感区分山洪、内涝与河洪，对流域防洪减灾与水利备考极具参考价值。

papers.title: Variations in erosive rainfall threshold and sediment production between karst and non-karst slopes
papers.abstractEn: Soil erosion on karst slopes exhibits a dual mechanism of surface erosion and underground leakage, producing erosive rainfall thresholds and sediment yields distinct from those on non-karst slopes. Neglecting this difference hampers soil erosion control and the assessment of desertification control benefits. To reveal these contrasts, this study monitored continuous rainfall-runoff-sediment events over eight years (2014-2021) on karst and non-karst plots at two soil and water conservation stations in Guizhou, China. Results show karst erosive rainfall is mainly short-duration and high-intensity, with long low-intensity rain contributing little. The karst erosive threshold ranges 35.4-45.6 mm (I30 31.2-36.2 mm/h), significantly higher than the non-karst range of 11.8-18.8 mm (I30 10.07-13.1 mm/h; P < 0.01). Soil and water conservation measures notably raised the threshold. Sediment yield on non-karst slopes was about 42 times that on karst slopes, and erosion related more closely to I30 on karst but to rainfall duration on non-karst slopes.
papers.abstractZh: 喀斯特坡面侵蚀兼具地表与地下漏失双重机制，其侵蚀性降雨阈值与产沙量异于非喀斯特。基于贵州两水保站8年观测：喀斯特侵蚀性降雨以短历时高强度为主，阈值35.4-45.6 mm，显著高于非喀斯特11.8-18.8 mm（P<0.01）；非喀斯特产沙量约为喀斯特42倍，且喀斯特侵蚀更依赖雨强I30、非喀斯特更依赖降雨历时。
papers.value: 对比喀斯特与非喀斯特坡面侵蚀性降雨阈值与产沙差异，对西南石漠化区水保措施配置与减沙效益评估有直接指导。

papers.title: Landslide predictions through combined rainfall threshold models
papers.abstractEn: Rainfall thresholds, defined as minimum rainfall amounts whose exceedance can trigger landslides, are widely used to predict landslide occurrence and form a core component of early warning systems. Although extensively studied, little attention has been paid to comparing the mathematical methods used to define such thresholds as lower bounds of empirical rainfall-landslide conditions, or to combining multiple available thresholds. This study tests and compares four methods - frequentist least squares, frequentist quantile regression, Bayesian quantile regression, and machine-learning symbolic regression - to define event cumulated-rainfall versus rainfall-duration (ED) thresholds from 2259 measurements (duration D in hours, cumulated rainfall E in mm) that triggered mostly shallow landslides in Italy between 2002 and 2012. The methods are compared at non-exceedance probabilities p = 0.01, 0.05, 0.10. A voting strategy is then proposed to combine the individual predictions into a single dichotomous, non-probabilistic landslide forecast applied to the dataset, clarifying how threshold definition and combination affect prediction reliability.
papers.abstractZh: 降雨阈值是可触发滑坡的最小降雨量，是预警核心。本文以意大利2002-2012年2259组致灾降雨，对比频率最小二乘、分位数回归、贝叶斯分位数回归与符号回归四种方法定义ED阈值，并在p=0.01、0.05、0.10下比较；提出投票策略合成单一二值滑坡预报，厘清阈值定义与组合对预测可靠性的影响。
papers.value: 系统比较降雨阈值定义方法与组合投票策略，可提升降雨型滑坡预警可靠性，对山区水保与滑坡灾害防御备考具重要意义。

papers.title: 基于地理过程的土壤侵蚀分区模型构建与应用
papers.abstractEn: Soil erosion regionalization is vital for guiding erosion control, yet traditional single-time-slice methods fail to reveal evolutionary processes. To improve accuracy, this study constructs a geographical-process-based soil erosion regionalization model (GPR-SE) that captures process similarity and heterogeneity: a convolutional autoencoder extracts spatial features and a long short-term memory network captures temporal features, which are fused into spatiotemporal features; silhouette and Davies-Bouldin indices select the best clustering method among K-means, fuzzy C-means, and self-organizing feature maps. Applying the model to Hailun City in the typical black soil region of Northeast China and using random forest to identify dominant factors, results show K-means is optimal at five clusters; precipitation (25.08%) and temperature (21.65%) are the dominant differentiating factors, followed by landform and erosion modulus; the study area is divided into four erosion-type zones, offering a reliable approach for targeted erosion control.
papers.abstractZh: 土壤侵蚀分区对治理重要，但传统单时间截面分区难揭示演化过程。本文构建地理过程分区模型：卷积自编码器与长短期记忆网络分别提取空间与时序特征；轮廓系数与戴维森堡丁指数优选聚类方法。以东北黑土区海伦市为例分区，随机森林识别主导因子，聚类数5时K-means最优，降水（25.08%）与温度（21.65%）为分异主导因子。
papers.value: 构建地理过程驱动的土壤侵蚀分区模型（GPR-SE），面向东北黑土区，为侵蚀精准治理与水土保持规划提供新方法。

papers.title: 基于无人机调查的黑土区浅沟侵蚀对降雨变化的响应及预测模型
papers.abstractEn: Ephemeral gullies are small channels formed by surface runoff that reappear at the same location after tillage; they are a leading erosion type threatening productivity in the black soil region of Northeast China. To reveal their interannual variation, UAV surveys were conducted over two consecutive years (late June-July 2022 and early June 2023) along transects in the Nenjiang-Binxian area, producing high-resolution models (about 3.8 cm). Among 66 units, those with gullies accounted for 75.78% (2022) and 74.24% (2023); in 2023 linear, areal, and volumetric densities dropped 31.67%, 36.72%, and 40.78% due to lower rainfall. A total of 366 gullies were mapped, with 2023 numbers at 70.23% of 2022 and average length, area, and volume at 83.94%, 76.45%, and 71.94%. Gully reformation depended on catchment area and runoff (P < 0.05). Using 73 gullies, power-law models linking length, area, and volume to average slope and runoff were built, supporting regional gully prediction and control.
papers.abstractZh: 浅沟是东北黑土区主要侵蚀类型之一，由地表径流冲刷形成。嫩江-宾县两年无人机调查显示：66单元浅沟2022、2023年占75.78%、74.24%；2023年浅沟长、密度降31.67%、36.72%；累计366条，2023年仅2022年70%。浅沟再现主因是集水面积与径流量差异（P<0.05），据此建幂函数模型供防治。
papers.value: 基于无人机遥感量化黑土区浅沟侵蚀年际变化并建预测模型，是水土流失遥感监测与侵蚀预报备考的优良范例。
